cross_package_notes.file: frontend/src/embed-main.ts:7 (owned by unit frontend/build-runtime alongside frontend/src/main.ts)
cross_package_notes.note: Upstream extracted --chat-code-* token custom properties out of chat-hljs.less into chat-hljs-theme.less and imported it in main.ts, omitting embed-main.ts; added import '@/components/css/chat-hljs-theme.less' to embed-main.ts so EmbedPage code blocks inherit light/dark syntax-highlight tokens.
Verified W6 lifecycle regression test asserting manual-knowledge-editor initGeneration fencing passes cleanly alongside all new upstream and Stage 2B tests (3033 passed, 0 failed).

invariants_checked: main.ts installs the offline TDesign icon guard prior to app creation, reconciles auth capabilities via genyee_token before router.isReady(), and logs unhandled errors under [GENYEE] without leaking tokens or host paths.
Both SPA (main.ts) and embedded widget (embed-main.ts) entrypoints import chat-hljs-theme.less, and zero files in frontend/ reference deleted chat-hljs-dark.less.
frontend/LICENSE, frontend/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, and frontend/public/tdesign-icons/** remain byte-identical.

findings.summary: Upstream moved all --chat-code-* syntax-highlight custom properties from chat-hljs.less into chat-hljs-theme.less and imported it only in main.ts, leaving --chat-code-* undefined in the embedded chat widget entrypoint (embed-main.ts).
findings.regression_test: both SPA and embed entrypoints load chat-hljs-theme.less and zero files reference deleted chat-hljs-dark.less

invariants_checked: AttachmentUpload fences upload progress, completion, status polling, and temporary-document deletion with sessionEpoch + disposed + reactive proxy tracking so switching sessions (including A -> B -> A) or unmounting never leaks or revives stale attachments.

GlobalCommandPalette and useCmdkSearch key KB/agent caches and in-flight discovery/search requests by user:effectiveTenantId, flushing stale results, closing the palette, dismissing any open ChatReferenceSourceView drawer, and cancelling pending focus retry RAF/timers on workspace switch, close, or unmount.

useStartChat and Input-field deliver prefill queries only after /platform/creatChat navigation succeeds (or duplicates onto the active composer), preserving current drafts on cancelled/redirected navigation and leaving embedded composers untouched.

manual-knowledge-editor fences initialize, loadKnowledgeBases, loadKnowledgeContent, and handleSave (draft + publish) with initGeneration and disconnects ResizeObserver on unmount so stale loads or saves from closed visits cannot overwrite, unlock, or close a reopened draft.

ChatReferenceSourceView validates web citation URLs via new URL (http:/https: with non-empty hostname), avoids empty-ID detail requests, refreshes kbName provenance when knowledgeBaseId hydrates on an open document, and increments loadVersion on unmount.

findings.summary: Upstream renamed W6's initGeneration token to loadVersion (regressing componentLifecycleRaces.test.ts) and left handleSave() unfenced across async getKnowledgeBaseById, uploadConfirmStore.open, updateManualKnowledge, and createManualKnowledge awaits, allowing an in-flight save from a closed visit to overwrite currentKnowledgeId, unlock saving, or close a newly opened draft.
findings.regression_test: an old in-flight save success/failure cannot close, unlock, or overwrite a reopened draft

findings.summary: GlobalCommandPalette stays mounted across workspace/user switches while useCmdkSearch permanently cached kbsLoaded/agentsLoaded and kept stale fileGroups/messageGroups and open sourceTarget drawers across effectiveTenantId changes; focusInputWithRetry also left RAF/setTimeout callbacks uncanceled on close/unmount.
findings.regression_test: workspace switch invalidates cached KBs and drops in-flight cross-workspace search results; workspace or user switch dismisses an open source drawer and closes the palette

findings.summary: ChatReferenceSourceView omitted knowledgeBaseId and knowledgeSource from its target watcher, skipped kbName provenance refresh when knowledgeBaseId hydrated on an already open document, accepted hostless 'https://' URLs via regex, called getKnowledgeDetails('') on empty knowledgeId, and lacked an onBeforeUnmount loadVersion fence.
findings.regression_test: hydrating knowledgeBaseId on the same document updates provenance and web citations reject hostless URLs

invariants_checked: All 6 locales (en-US, ja-JP, ko-KR, ru-RU, zh-CN, zh-TW) maintain 100% key and interpolation placeholder parity, including new commandPalette.errors.{knowledge,messages} keys and Traditional Chinese terminology normalization ('支援') in zh-TW.ts.
Zero legacy upstream brand/prefix, mini-program, or host-path residues exist in any locale file.

citationMarkdown escapes all HTML attributes/text, blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript: URLs via URL parsing, preserves blank lines after closing $$ display-math and fenced-code delimiters, and leaves literal <kb/>, <web/>, and [[wiki]] inside variable-length CommonMark fences and inline code spans untouched.

markdownPreviewImages resolves relative sibling images strictly within normalized knowledge-base folder boundaries, caps paginated folder scans at MAX_PREVIEW_IMAGE_LIST_PAGES = 20, validates generated URLs with isSafePreviewImageHref (revoking rejected blob: URLs immediately), and ignores image syntax inside CommonMark fences, HTML comments, inline code, and indented code.
markdownTableNormalize repairs MarkItDown spurious empty/separator table prefixes and escaped pipes while leaving pipe-prefixed lines inside CommonMark fenced code blocks untouched.

sessionMarkdown preserves Markdown hard breaks, fenced code whitespace, and literal <kb/>/<web/> inside code while normalizing and percent-encoding reference http(s) URLs so parentheses/spaces/quotes cannot break out of Markdown links.

pageFill, pageText, automationSchedule, and agent-tool-display reject overlapping ambiguous text anchors in O(N), preserve user edits on undo, reject DST-skipped/invalid wall-clock schedules while retaining exact one-shot instants, and count distinct knowledge documents accurately.

findings.summary: sessionMarkdown interpolated raw /^https?:\/\//i reference URLs into Markdown links without URL parsing or parenthesis/whitespace encoding (allowing 'https://example.com/p) [Click](javascript:alert(1))' link breakout) and stripped literal <kb/>/<web/> inside code blocks; citationMarkdown prematurely closed 4-backtick fences on inner 3-backtick lines and emitted unencoded spaces/unescaped fallback brackets or HTML in stripCitationTagsForMarkdown; markdownTableNormalize mutated pipe-prefixed lines inside fenced code blocks.
findings.regression_test: buildSessionMarkdown encodes parentheses and spaces in reference URLs and rejects malformed schemes; buildSessionMarkdown preserves literal <kb/> and <web/> inside inline and fenced code blocks; preserves literal citations inside 4-backtick fences containing 3-backtick lines; stripCitationTagsForMarkdown normalizes URL spaces/quotes and sanitizes fallback bracket labels; pipe-prefixed lines inside CommonMark fenced code blocks are left untouched

verification_commands: (cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1536" ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test src/utils/agent-tool-display.test.mjs src/utils/automationSchedule.test.ts src/utils/citationMarkdownMath.test.mjs src/utils/markdownPreviewImageFences.test.ts src/utils/markdownTableNormalize.test.ts src/utils/pageFill.test.ts src/utils/pageText.overlap.test.ts src/utils/pageText.test.ts src/utils/sessionMarkdown.test.ts src/utils/w6_utils_security.test.ts) (exit 0)

invariants_checked: AgentEditorModal requires a Rerank model in smart-reasoning mode only when agentRequiresRerankModel confirms built-in search_knowledge is active alongside knowledge bases, renders prompt actions in non-overlapping footer rows without v-html, and cleans up all popup/catalog/highlight timers on unmount.

AutomationEditor fences trigger validation previews with previewSeq + clearTimeout(previewTimer) and fences create/update saves with editorVersion so closing, unmounting, or reopening (including A -> B -> A) cancels pending previews and ignores stale save completions.

AgentStreamDisplay computes search result file counts via countSearchResultFiles (coercing numeric count/fileCount values before strong-tag interpolation), sanitizes streamed Markdown and citation HTML, and removes root click/keydown capture listeners on unmount.

KnowledgeBase fences auto-fill viewport pagination with documentPageGeneration + isCurrentKb(currentKbId) and backs off when a page returns no additional rows, preventing infinite auto-pagination loops or cross-KB state pollution.
KnowledgeBaseEditorModal places Wiki instruction counters and AssistantActionButton in a non-overlapping footer with kbEditorLoadGeneration async fencing and listener cleanup.

FAQEntryManager enforces a 20 MiB import file size cap, matches extensions case-insensitively, isolates CSV/Excel header records with Object.create(null) against __proto__ pollution, validates JSON array object items, and sanitizes operational fields (answer_strategy, booleans, positive integer tag_id, string lists) while fencing polling by kbSwitchGen + isFaqUnmounted.

findings.summary: FAQEntryManager read arbitrarily large import files into memory without a byte cap, rejected uppercase .JSON/.CSV/.XLSX extensions, stored CSV/Excel row columns in plain {} objects susceptible to __proto__ header collisions, and threw unhandled TypeErrors or forwarded unvalidated answer_strategy/tag_id/non-string-array values on malformed JSON imports.
findings.regression_test: FAQ import rejects oversized files, handles uppercase extensions, sanitizes malformed JSON fields, and isolates __proto__ CSV headers
